items.title: 21.1.2 Defence Provided by Digestive and Respiratory Tracts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of defence by the digestive and respiratory tracts (PDF 171-172).

blocks.text: Insaan jo khana khata hai us mein bohat se bacteria hote hain. In mein se zyada tar munh (oral cavity) ke thook (saliva) se mar jate hain, jis mein lysozyme bhi hota hai. Maide (stomach) ke taqatwar hazme ke tezab (acids) aur aant (intestine) ke protein hazam karne wale enzymes bhi bacteria ko maar dete hain.

Jis hawa mein hum saans lete hain us mein bhi bohat se microbes hote hain. Naak ki guha (nasal cavity) ke ciliated epithelial cells (baal jaise cilia wale cells) bohat se bacteria ko hawa ke raaste mein dakhil hone se pehle hi phansa lete hain. Chhoti bronchi aur bronchioles ki andaruni teh ke cells chipchipi mucus (balgham) ki teh chhorte hain jo microbes ko garam aur nam phephron (lungs) tak pohanchne se pehle phansa leti hai. In naliyon ke cells par lage cilia is mucus ko musalsal oopar ki taraf dhakelte rehte hain, jahan se ise nigla ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab balgham ke liye “mucous” likhti hai (“sticky mucous”, “the mucous upward”). Sahi naam mucus hai; “mucous” sifat (adjective) hai, jaise mucous cells (balgham banane wale cells).

blocks.alt: Trachea ke epithelium ki patti: columnar cells aur un ke beech mucous cells, khuli satah par cilia, aur cilia ke oopar balgham (mucous layer) jis mein phanse hue jaraseem. Oopar ka teer balgham ki harkat dikhata hai. Chhota khaaka sar, trachea aur phephre dikhata hai; trachea par aik dabba.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.3: Trachea ka epithelium, phanse hue jaraseem ke saath (kitab ki Figure 21.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Mucous cells, Movement of mucus, Trapped microbe, Mucous layer, Cilia, Columnar cell.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 21.3 mein teer par 'Movement of mucous' likha hai. Sahi 'Movement of mucus' hai, is liye khaake mein yahi likha gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Trachea ke columnar cells par cilia hain aur un ke beech mucous cells mucus banate hain. Mucus ki teh microbes ko phansa leti hai aur cilia is teh ko oopar gale ki taraf dhakelte hain; wahan yeh nigal li jati hai aur maide ka tezab microbes ko maar deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Saans ki naliyon ki mucus ko nigal lena difa mein kaise madad deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Mucus mein phanse microbes maide mein pohanch jate hain jahan taqatwar tezab unhein maar deta hai.

items: Digestive tract: thook ka lysozyme, maide ke tezab aur aant ke protein hazam karne wale enzymes bacteria maarte hain.
Respiratory tract: naak ke ciliated cells bacteria phansate hain; bronchi aur bronchioles ki mucus microbes pakarti hai aur cilia use oopar le ja kar nigalne ke liye dete hain.
